## What
Add instruction to plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md Phase 2 Step 2 (Provenance Tracking section) directing the orchestrator to wrap inferred input source noun phrases with <<inferred:source-name>> structural markers when drafting the epic spec narrative.

## Why
Story 1df2-5125 DD1: without this instruction, the orchestrator drafts spec narrative without tagging inferred sources, so the approval gate cannot visually flag them for user review.

## Acceptance Criteria
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md Phase 2 Provenance Tracking section (around line 376) contains instruction to emit <<inferred:source-name>> markers around inferred input source noun phrases in the spec narrative
- The instruction references the contract at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md
- test_inferred_marker_instruction tests go GREEN after this change
- No other SKILL.md tests regress

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md (Provenance Tracking section ~line 376-386)
